title: 1987 Donruss #276 Roger Clemens Boston Red Sox Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is an original 1987 Donruss baseball card featuring Roger Clemens of the Boston Red Sox. The card is part of the base set, with card number 276. It is a standard-sized trading card in English language, not autographed. The card is from the Major League (MLB) and manufactured in the United States. It's a vintage collectible item for fans of baseball and sports trading cards.
